to: `request`: the asked character only. `new` and `lost`: each online character of both accounts

variants.name: Request
variants.when: Another character sent `friend` with `event: "request"` and your name.

variants.name: New friend
variants.when: A character accepted a friend request (`friend` with `event: "accept"`). Each online character of both accounts gets it, with the list of its own account.

confirm.note: `name` is `R.e2.name` / `R.e1.name`: the account name of the other side

variants.name: Lost friend
variants.when: A character of one of the two accounts sent `friend` with `event: "unfriend"`. Each online character of both accounts gets it.

FriendRequest.summary: A friend request from another character.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The character that asks. To accept, send `friend` with `event: "accept"` and this name.

FriendNew.summary: Your account has a new friend.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The account name (`user.name`) of the new friend, not a character name (node/server.js:12108-12109).

fields.name: friends
fields.description: The new friend list of your account: account ids (`owner` values). Replace your old list.

fields.name: friends
fields.description: The new friend list of your account: account ids (`owner` values). Replace your old list. The server does not say which friend left.

senders.what: The `/new_friend` route of the game server. The web server calls it from `update_characters` after `friend` `accept` (node/server.js:12108-12109).
The `/lost_friend` route of the game server. The web server calls it from `update_characters` after `friend` `unfriend` (node/server.js:12180-12181).
`update_characters`: one HTTP call for each online character of the account, to the server of that character.
